title: Carol A
content: I was escorted away from my body into a vast darkness by two beings. I wasn't fearful of the passage because of their reassuring presence. I felt safe and content to leave my body and go with them. They seemed male, clothed in glistening white tunics, mostly human in form but not solid as humans are here. They both had peaceful, kind demeanors. They escorted me to a room like an anteroom. I could detect crowds of spirits and divine music flowing toward a great light in another area, but that area was blocked to me. Still, I could hear magnetic music unlike anything I'd ever heard. It seemed three-dimensional and directional, flowing toward what I assumed was the creator. I was curious but understood that area wasn't part of why I was there. My guides immediately grasped my curiosity and gave off gentle amusement while redirecting my attention to the room we were in. In this room, I felt awe. It was high-tech and streamlined, with walls like frosted glass block. There was a peaceful white that radiated gentle light. My spirit escorts seemed assigned to me and knew me intimately. I sensed they'd been with me always, at least since my birth on earth. One guide seemed more senior and communicated more with me. There were no words, but evidence of clear understanding, even of spontaneous questions. The main answer provided was a godly perspective on the problem of evil. I'd struggled with the question, "If God is all-loving, how can he allow such horrors?" I was allowed to gaze into a high-tech, stacked-drawer system of time and history. I looked backward through thousands of layers representing intervals of time. The layers interacted and came alive as I viewed them. I could see individual layers and their vertical implications from past to present. Everything was intentionally woven together, forming a beautiful three-dimensional tapestry from above. Events that humans consider tragic were darker colors but didn't ruin the overall beauty because these events were a small part of the fullness of time. Seeing the continuity of events that were normally beyond human grasp, I accepted that all that occurs is part of an intricate tapestry woven through the ages. I felt touched that God knew my anguish and sent these guides to help with my despair over man's inhumanity and God's seeming lack of intervention. In that room, my mind had no human limits. I absorbed information with perfect understanding. I wish I could have brought that ability back. I also wish I'd asked my guides' names, but I didn't because they felt so familiar at the time. Over the years, I've sometimes felt them at my side during times of distress. The experience showed me we are loved and watched over. God knows our every thought and action. I now believe in personal angels. Before this experience, I thought that was nonsense.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, I was emotionally distraught and praying intensely., Other (briefly specify), I was not physically traumatized.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I was completely myself. My personality wasn't altered, but I was granted the mental capacity to absorb an overwhelming amount of history and all its implications.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When interacting with the guides in the history-archive room and when viewing the archives.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I did not have a perception of time passing. It might have been one second or half an hour.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Perhaps the word 'enhanced' best describes it. Since my vision, I've heard people call it hyper-real, which is true. The haze and film of human existence were swept away, leaving great clarity of thought and perception.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I heard thought-to-thought communication from one mind to another. Sound took on multiple dimensions. My senior guide had the kindest voice, though he wasn't speaking aloud.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, It wasn't a tunnel but rather a vast, nondescript darkness before arriving at the heavenly chamber.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, The light, like the music, had qualities unlike anything on Earth.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I've described it already.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt peace, intrigue, curiosity, wonder, realization, loving kindness, and a sense of being completely understood.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others, Everything about life here on earth fitting together, but not about the universe or myself.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: This wasn't a life review focused on my life. I could see my life in conjunction with all life as I explored the advanced history archives.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future, I did see some of what we will face in the near future, but the awareness of those things seemed scrubbed from my memory upon my return to my body. I can just hear skeptics doubting, but that is what occurred.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, There was never a question in my mind. It was made clear by my guides that I was only there for insight and instruction, and that it was a limited visit.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Protestant, I did not doubt God's existence, but I was in a stressful and very difficult time.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain, It's hard to analyze this because I did have the experience, and I don't know how I would feel if I hadn't had it.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Protestant, I am spiritually sensitive to God's will and purpose in my life.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I had no idea of the intricate interconnectedness of all that is present, along with the past and future.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, The two beings were the guides I referred to earlier.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I clearly perceived all the horizontal and vertical connections of all mankind's actions that create the overall tapestry of life on earth.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, As previously described - pertaining to interconnectedness of actions and events down through time to create a beautiful tapestry.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I've explained that above. I'm beginning to fatigue.
Uncertain, This is a general observation rather than a specific observation. The entire atmosphere and all that occurs is imbued with love. It permeates everything.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: This has been exhausting. I feel like I've been turned inside out.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, Everything we experience shifts who we are, and who we are is the basis of our relationships, so it is a given.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, It was nothing like Earth. The materials, atmosphere, colors, light, music, telepathy, and peace were indescribable. It's like trying to describe another planet without the right vocabulary.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, It seems branded in my mind. But perhaps this is because I've replayed it so often in my mind to derive comfort.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I had read R. Moody's and E. Kübler-Ross's books as a teenager.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, As I've heard others say, it was more real than this life. I felt that way.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real, I'm a skeptic on these things. Could it have all been in my mind? Maybe? It didn't and doesn't seem so, but...?
